name: pomo
about: A Pomodoro timer for the browser.
change: Redesign pomo into a dark, distraction-free focus app. Replace the light card with a full-screen dark layout and a large circular SVG progress ring around the time. Rename the modes to "Deep work" (50 minutes) and "Recharge" (10 minutes). Add keyboard shortcuts: Space starts or pauses, R resets, 1 and 2 switch modes. Move all DOM and rendering code out of app.js into a new ui.js and delete app.js.
upstream: Long breaks every 4 sessions, session dots, chime; rename modes to presets
wanted: Accessibility fixes are welcome, especially for screen readers.
fix: Announce the current mode and the end of each session to screen readers with an aria-live region.
